description: Four random voltages and four random gates grown from a numbered seed, so the same seed replays the same sequence

params.text: Sets the seed, a whole number from 0 to 9999; a new number takes effect only when the reseed button is pressed or a trigger reaches the reseed input
Loads the seed and starts the sequence again from its beginning
Switches the random numbers between an even spread and a gaussian one clustered around the middle
Scales that row's random number, 0 to 10, before that row's offset is added
Shifts that row's random voltage, -10V to 10V, after it has been scaled
Sets the chance that row's gate fires on a clock, 0 to 100%
Sets how far that row's MULTIPLY input moves the scaling, and in which direction
Sets how far that row's OFFSET input moves the offset, and in which direction
Sets how far that row's PROBABILITY input moves the chance, and in which direction
Switches that row's gate output between following the clock and firing a short trigger

inputs.text: Sets the seed from a voltage instead of the knob, 0V to 10V covering the whole 0 to 9999 range
A trigger here loads the seed and starts the sequence again
Each rising edge here draws a fresh set of random voltages and gates
Above 5V the random numbers take a gaussian spread and below it an even one, overriding the GAUSSIAN button
Voltage that moves that row's scaling, by the amount that row's attenuverter sets
Voltage that moves that row's offset, by the amount that row's attenuverter sets
Voltage that moves that row's gate chance, by the amount that row's attenuverter sets

outputs.text: That row's random number scaled and offset, clamped between -10V and 10V, held until the next clock
Fires when that row's chance allows it on a clock, carrying the clock voltage while the clock is high, or a short trigger with that row's MODE set to trigger

notes: the lamp beside the seed reads green while the running sequence matches the seed shown and red once the seed has been changed but not yet loaded
nothing is drawn until a clock is patched into the clock input, and a new seed number takes effect only when the reseed button is pressed or a trigger arrives at the reseed input.

inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.2: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 5V · stepped · one channel only
